playbookOutputs: Completed CSOS Annual Return (Form CS1 / CS2) & Statutory CSOS Levy Reconciliation Schedule
CSOS Connect Filing Confirmation & Compliance Receipt
playbookCommonFailures: Audited Annual Financial Statements for the scheme are not yet signed off by the scheme auditor and trustees at the AGM
CSOS quarterly levies match total administrative + reserve levies instead of applying the statutory formula per individual unit

informationToProvide.label: Scheme Name, Scheme Number & Physical Address
informationToProvide.aiHint: E.g., SS Sunset Villas (SS 123/2015) or Sunset Valley Homeowners Association.

informationToProvide.label: Latest Audited Annual Financial Statements (AFS) / Annual Budget
informationToProvide.aiHint: Signed AFS or AGM approved budget showing total annual levies.

informationToProvide.label: Current Trustees / Directors Contact Details
informationToProvide.aiHint: List of trustees with ID numbers and email addresses.

informationToProvide.label: Unit Count & Monthly Administrative Levy Schedule per Unit (Excel or PDF)
alternatives: PDF levy roll from managing agent
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload the scheme unit levy roll showing each unit monthly levy so we can reconcile the statutory CSOS levy calculation (2% of monthly levy above R500, capped at R40/unit).
informationToProvide.aiHint: Community scheme levy roll or schedule listing all units and their monthly administrative levies.

informationToProvide.label: CSOS Connect Portal Login Email / Username (If Already Registered on CSOS Connect)
informationToProvide.helpText: Provide the CSOS Connect login email if the scheme is already linked on CSOS Connect.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Collect scheme financials, trustee details, and levy budget
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Scheme number, AFS, and unit count confirmed

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Compile CSOS Form CS1 / CS2 and levy reconciliation
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: CSOS submission forms and levy schedules compiled

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Submit return to CSOS regional office / portal
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Lodged with CSOS and tracking reference generated

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Deliver filing confirmation and levy receipt to client
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Submission receipt and next year diary date delivered to trustees
